page_title: OSA 3-2 OVI | Osasuna v Oviedo 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.

90+7' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) is going to have a crack himself.
90+5' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
90+4' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo) replacing Lucas Ahijado.
90+4' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Asier Osambela (Osasuna) will replace Aimar Oroz.
90+2' 3 - 2 What a beauty from just outside the box! Victor Munoz (Osasuna) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the net.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
88' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves (Real Oviedo) gets a yellow card, off the field.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luka Ilic (Real Oviedo) comes onto the pitch so that Haissem Hassan can be given a rest.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
82' Referee Alejandro Quintero signals NO PENALTY for Oviedo after a VAR review!
82' There's a break in play and referee Alejandro Quintero must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Oviedo using VAR. This could be interesting!
80' Surely that's handball by one of the Osasuna players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
77' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Quintero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
75' 2 - 2 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2.
73' Substitution. Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) will be replaced by Flavien Boyomo.
73' Substitution. Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) makes his way off the pitch and Kike Barja comes on as his replacement.
73' Here comes a substitution. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Torro.
71' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to substitute Santiago Colombatto and he is replaced by Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo).
71' Today's match ends for Kwasi Sibo who will be replaced by Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo).

68' 1 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom left corner. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
67' Oviedo have been awarded a corner kick.
66' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) climbs higher than the defenders inside the box and plants a towering header against the crossbar. What a great chance!
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is coming onto the pitch as Moi Gomez cannot continue after picking up an injury.

64' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
62' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
59' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Quintero no option but to blow his whistle.

58' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner kick and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.
57' The ball is out of play and Osasuna manage to earn a corner.
57' Javi Galan (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Osasuna force their opponents to concede a corner.
55' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.

54' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

53' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Sergio Herrera anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
52' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
51' Oviedo fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.

50' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Sergio Herrera stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner. Oviedo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
48' The linesman signals a throw-in for Osasuna.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Alejandro Quintero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 1 Goal! Javi Galan puts a cross into the box and finds Ante Budimir (Osasuna), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
43' The Ante Budimir (Osasuna) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Alejandro Quintero rules it out for a handball.
40' 0 - 1 Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) rises above the defence to meet the corner and powers his header low inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
40' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Oviedo.
38' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
36' David Costas (Real Oviedo) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
36' Alejandro Quintero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by David Costas (Real Oviedo) and blew his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Osasuna.
35' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' The Osasuna players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
32' The ball is behind the touchline and Osasuna will take a throw-in.
30' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is about to take a corner kick.
29' Javi Galan (Osasuna) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Osasuna get a corner.
27' Javi Galan (Osasuna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
23' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
23' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
21' Oviedo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

21' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) drives a shot towards the bottom left corner from inside the box, but Sergio Herrera leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away. Oviedo have been awarded a corner kick.
19' The resulting set piece from Oviedo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
18' Oviedo are seeing far more of the ball now.
15' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
13' The referee blows his whistle, Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
12' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
11' Corner kick. Osasuna will have an opportunity.
11' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Osasuna get a free kick.
10' Some patient build-up play from Osasuna as they look to unlock the defence.
8' Osasuna have been awarded a free kick.
7' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Quintero had an easy-decision to make.
5' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) skips past a few defenders in the penalty area and strikes a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a superb save.
4' Some great controlled play and passing from Osasuna. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) drives a shot towards the left side of the goal from inside the box, but Sergio Herrera leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
1' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Quintero.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
